title: org show JSON output
description: Schema for the JSON output of 'org show <locator> --format json'.

locator.description: Canonical OrgLocator string for the resolved entry or file node.

file.description: Path to the org file containing the resolved node.

line.description: 1-based start line number of the resolved node.

end_line.description: 1-based inclusive end line number of the extracted slice.

level.description: Heading level (0 for a level-0 file node, >= 1 for headings).

title.description: Heading title text or level-0 file #+TITLE: / file stem.

tags.description: Tags attached directly to the heading or #+FILETAGS: for file nodes.

scheduled.description: SCHEDULED timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD [HH:MM] format, or null.

deadline.description: DEADLINE timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD [HH:MM] format, or null.

closed.description: CLOSED timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD [HH:MM] format, or null.

planning.description: Planning timestamps attached to the heading.

total.description: Total number of plain-list checklist items in the node's own body.

checklist_summary.description: Aggregate counts across the node's plain-list checklist items.

checklist.description: Plain-list checklist items in the node's own body.

line.description: 1-based line number of the checklist item.

no_children.description: Whether child headings were omitted via --no-children.

truncated.description: Whether content was truncated to honour --max-chars.

char_count.description: Number of Unicode scalar values in content.

content.description: Bounded raw Org slice for the resolved node.

markdown.description: Optional bounded GitHub Flavored Markdown rendering when requested.

files_scanned.description: Number of org files scanned during locator resolution.

telemetry.description: Execution duration and file-scan observability telemetry.
